notes: Technical description for Sepolia (chain 11155111), native ETH currency0 and IMDO currency1. IMDO funds treasury purchases and retirement of ecological credits on Regen Network; these contracts do not execute or verify retirements. Holders receive no payouts, rewards, yield or staking. Both contracts are in src/IMDOFeeHook.sol. IMDOToken has no constructor arguments, plain untaxed transfers, public self-burn, no post-deployment mint, owner, blacklist, pause, trading gate or upgrade path. IMDOFeeHook takes the manager then the launch token; both bindings are immutable. Its local BaseHookFee is a self-contained adaptation of the OpenZeppelin pattern, not an imported library. All seven declared permissions match getHookPermissions; the constructor checks all 14 address bits equal 0x25d4 (9684). Only PoolManager may call enabled callbacks. beforeInitialize binds exactly one pool and accepts only the complete pinned launch key: ETH/IMDO, LP fee 3000 ppm (constant POOL_FEE), tick spacing 60 (constant TICK_SPACING), hooks = this contract; any other fee tier, tick spacing or currency pair reverts with InvalidPool. pool.fee 3000 is therefore the only tier the accepted hook initializes with. Initial sqrtPriceX96 is 2^96, matching the repository's test fixture: 1 IMDO per ETH with 18 decimals. This price is an explicit assumption because the brief and deployment script supply no initial price. The launch factory must deploy the hook and initialize the pool with it attached in one transaction; script/Deploy.s.sol is the offline dry run that deploys token and mined hook, attests the pinned key, and does not initialize the pool. Buys pay zero hook fee; ordinary LP fees apply in both directions. Sells use the settled afterSwap token input and a pool-specific reserve snapshot lagged one block. Cumulative sold/reserve below 100 bps pays 0 ppm; 100 to below 300 pays 5000 ppm; 300 to below 500 pays 10000 ppm; 500 or more pays 20000 ppm. The immutable bracket cap is 20000 ppm (2%); a zero lagged reserve (launch block) uses the cap. Transient storage aggregates each tx.origin's sells across routers and swap modes within one transaction, with cumulative catch-up billing. Per-leg hard cap: no leg ever pays more than 2% of its own gross ETH output (exact input) or settled IMDO input (exact output), even when carrying catch-up for earlier legs under the same origin; any remainder carries to the next sell leg of the same transaction and never to another transaction. Exact-input fees are ETH sent directly from PoolManager to immutable treasury 0xb1eC9d1C36974d05eb9889eBf8A150b05791E559 when the manager holds enough ETH and the transfer succeeds within an 80000-gas budget; otherwise the fee accrues as an ERC-6909 claim. Exact-output fees are additional IMDO always recorded as an ERC-6909 claim, never taken inside afterSwap, and no ETH treasury fee applies in that mode. Permissionless harvest() redeems only recorded claims: ETH to the treasury, IMDO burned. Its two legs are independent: a treasury that rejects ETH leaves the ETH claim recorded and redeemable later while the IMDO claim is still burned; harvest does not revert for that. No setters, admin roles or upgrades exist. The hook returns zero liquidity deltas and no LP fee override. Pool LP fees accrue to liquidity positions; the factory collects its position's fees for its existing configured recipients, with protocol fees remaining in PoolManager accounting. Swarm Merkle claims remain plain untaxed transfers. Production factory recipient addresses and a live factory rehearsal are absent from the supplied repository; local tests use a factory-style position and Merkle distributor. Solidity 0.8.26 and Cancun or later are required. README.md describes behavior and script attestation. This manifest does not set launch policy or certify deployment, admission or an audit; no audit is claimed.
